basic_info.description: Perched to capture San Francisco's natural beauty, this end lot Merced Heights house is detached on 3 sides and features corner windows that frame sweeping City vistas all the way to the distant ocean. Located near Merced Heights Playground, Minnie & Lovie Ward Rec Center, Ocean Avenue shops and eateries, City College, Stonestown Mall, and major commuter routes, this home offers convenience and potential. Inside, the layout is well-proportioned, offering a spacious living room perfect for cozy nights by the fireplace or taking in radiant sunsets. A formal dining area and eat-in kitchen create space to gather. Two generous rear-facing bedrooms, with eastern exposure, overlook the backyard. A full bathroom features both a tub and separate shower as well as a skylight for natural light. The expansive garage offers room to park two vehicles, store essentials, or explore expansion possibilities. Whether you're a homeowner with vision, an investor with ambition, or a developer seeking opportunity, this property invites your imagination to take root.
